subject: general
question:
Select the option that rectifies the incorrectly spelt words in the given sentence.

They have legitimete grounds to engagge users.

options.text: They have legetimate grounds to engag users.
They have legitimete grounds to engaege users.
They have legitimate grounds to engage users.
They have legitamate grounds to engage users.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'They have legitimate grounds to engage users'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This is a **spelling-in-context **question.
 
• We need to choose an** appropriate option** that rectifies the incorrectly spelled words in the given sentence.
 
• Here, the spellings of 'legitimete' and 'engagge' are erroneous in the given question.
 
• Their correct spellings are** 'Legitimate' **and** 'engage'** respectively.
 
• These two-word spellings are correct in marked **option number 3.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Legitimate **means reasonable or acceptable.(तर्कसंगत या स्‍वीकार्य).
 
• ** Engage **means to interest or attract somebody.(आकृष्‍ट करना या (काम में) लगाना)
